final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), type_averages AS (SELECT type, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM event_averages GROUP BY type), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS value FROM type_averages) SELECT t.type, t.average_ratio, t.average_ratio / NULLIF(o.value, 0) FROM type_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL
